BrochureContent.Content:
Striking rural and coastal views, beautifully landscaped gardens and an exceptional standard of finish combine to create this impressive three-bedroom family home in the heart of West Cork.
Located in Dunbeacon, Durrus, this outstanding residence enjoys uninterrupted panoramic views across the Sheep's Head Peninsula and out to the waters of Dunmanus Bay. Featuring beautifully maintained grounds, the property offers the perfect mix of privacy, comfort and natural beauty.
The home is presented immaculately throughout and finished to a high standard, with bright, spacious accommodation. The interiors enjoy a natural flow, while large windows capture the views from many of the principal rooms.
Outside, the property is equally impressive. A gravelled driveway leads through entrance walls to beautifully manicured gardens with mature planting, colourful borders and expansive lawns. A tranquil stream meanders through the grounds, complemented by a pretty bridge. There is also a secluded sunken seating area—an idyllic spot to relax and enjoy the outdoors.
Located just 7km from Durrus Village, 10km from the thriving harbour village of Schull and 17km from the market town of Bantry, the property is perfectly positioned to enjoy everything West Cork has to offer, from coastal walks and sailing to award-winning restaurants, cafés and local artisan producers.
This is a very special property offering an exceptional lifestyle.

Features:
Gravelled driveway
Garage
Garden shed
Beautifully maintained gounds
Countryside and coastal views

OFCH
Solar panels providing hot water
Private well
Bio septic tank

Interested parties should investigate independently as to the accuracy of all details, including measurements, boundaries, area, BER rating, and available services. In addition, all apparatus, fixtures, fittings or services should be thoroughly tested to assess their working condition.
Photographs and videos are for guidance purposes only and may show items (such as furniture) that are not included in the sale unless specifically agreed between the parties.
